nodes.description: Private owner address set in constructor to msg.sender; used as privileged gate in ensure, delegate, _mints, init, batchSend and setTradeAddress.
Public mapping(address=>uint) of token balances; read and updated in transferFrom, _mints, batchSend and the ERC20 core.
Public nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) of spending allowances; modified in approve and transferFrom.
Private mapping(address=>uint256) counting per-address sale transfers; incremented in transferFrom and checked through condition.
Private mapping(address=>bool) whitelist used by ensure to bypass sale conditions; set in _mints.
Private minimum sale amount, scaled by decimals in init and enforced in condition.
Private maximum sale amount, scaled by decimals in init and enforced in condition.
Private maximum number of sale transfers per address; set in init and enforced in condition.
Address whitelisted by owner via setTradeAddress and checked in ensure as a bypass path.
Public total token supply, fixed in the constructor.
Constant uint public decimals = 18, used to scale mint/init amounts.
Constant address of the Uniswap router compared in ensure as a whitelist bypass.
Public payable transfer(address,uint); forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
Public payable transferFrom(address,address,uint); handles allowance, calls ensure, and performs unchecked balance updates.
Internal view gate that whitelists owner, UNI, the computed pair, tradeAddress and canSale addresses, otherwise delegates to condition.
Public payable approve(address,uint); writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal view sale-condition checker using _saleNum, _onSaleNum, _minSale and _maxSale.
Public payable delegate(address,bytes); owner-only arbitrary delegatecall to attacker-supplied address and calldata.
Public mint function restricted to owner or a hardcoded address; rewrites balanceOf[spender] and sets canSale.
Owner-only init(uint256,uint256,uint256) that sets _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
Owner-only payable batchSend(address[],uint); computes total = _value * _tos.length and updates balances in a loop without SafeMath.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress whitelist variable.
Internal pure Uniswap pair-address computation used by ensure for whitelisting.
Payable constructor initializing name, symbol, totalSupply, owner balance and an unlimited allowance to the UNI router.
Internal ERC20._transfer(address,address,uint) using SafeMath for balance updates.
SafeERC20 helper performing a low-level .call to an arbitrary token address with arbitrary encoded data.
ERC20.transferFrom(address,address,uint) that delegates accounting to _transfer and _approve.
msg.sender used in transferFrom to authorize allowance spending on behalf of _from.
msg.sender compared against owner before the arbitrary delegatecall in delegate().
msg.sender compared against owner before the batch balance loop in batchSend.
msg.sender checked against owner or the hardcoded privileged address in _mints.
a.delegatecall(b) executes attacker-controlled bytecode in the contract's storage context.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value performed without SafeMath, allowing wrap-around.
total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend with no overflow protection.
address(token).call(data) forwards arbitrary calldata to an externally supplied token contract.
